purpose: Predeclared qualification requirements and targets. This freeze records no successful qualification run or production acceptance.

functionalMatrix.additionalRequirements: Q-01 through Q-12 in support/qualification/0.2.0-coverage.md remain required; the functional matrix alone is insufficient.
functionalMatrix.sourceChanges: Move plan-store alerting from lifecycle to certificates and PostgreSQL reference data from certificates to data-plane. Master CI run 37420035400 passed in 92m45s; its slowest lifecycle spent 20m02s on plan-store alerting before the upgrade fault window. Rebalance the existing nine suites without adding phases or scenarios. All 17 phases, 345 scenario/engine/family rows, supported minors and platforms, observation windows, and Q-01 through Q-12 targets remain unchanged. Revision 42 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.13.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 54 adds the data-plane scenario postgresql-extension-drift, which stores Ptah v0.14.0's feature category for a dropped PostgreSQL extension through a cluster; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 55 adds the phase configmap-sources to the schema-approvals suite: a schema and a migration sequence read from ConfigMaps with no registry, edits to a selected and an unselected key, snapshot retention, and a replaced snapshot the Pod refuses. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 57 adds the phase git-sources to the schema-approvals suite: a schema and a migration sequence read from Git over HTTPS and SSH, a branch that moves without and with a selected change, and a credential granted for another host. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 58 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.15.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 59 adds the scenarios git-schema-pinned, git-force-push and git-source-refused to the phase git-sources. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 60 moves the phases configmap-sources and git-sources from the schema-approvals suite to data-plane, because schema-approvals with both ran past the 90-minute job limit. No phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 61 adds the scenario git-source-policy to the phase git-sources and moves the phase reference-data-postgresql from data-plane to lifecycle, because data-plane came within two minutes of the 90-minute job limit. No phase, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 62 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.16.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 66 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.17.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 68 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.18.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 71 adds the scenario configmap-unreadable-source to the phase configmap-sources and git-source-unreadable to git-sources. Revision 73 adds the data-plane scenario database-reachable-kind to the configmap-sources phase, which drives a PtahSchema and a PtahMigration to DatabaseReachable=False with reason AuthenticationFailed and back to True; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 74 adds the scenario oci-unreadable-schema to the phase dataplane. Revision 75 adds the scenario configmap-refused-statement to the phase configmap-sources. Revision 76 adds the data-plane scenario postgresql-login-visibility-drift, which runs drift detection under the login the databases page documents with a table another role created, and moves the line naming the Ptah build under test to the v0.22.0 release image; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 78 adds the scenario plan-stale-only-on-replacement to the phase schema-approvals. Revision 79 adds the scenario pod-configuration-error to the phase dataplane and pod-configuration-past-deadline to the phases migration-runtime-postgresql and migration-runtime-mysql. Revision 80 adds the scenario apply-asks-for-the-realm-lease to the phases migration-runtime-postgresql and migration-runtime-mysql. Revision 81 adds the scenario approval-target-login-change to the phase schema-approvals, which moves a schema to a second login after approval and after a finished Apply and ends each proof the way a person would; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 82 splits the nine suites into fourteen, because on CI run 42372668755 data-plane passed the 90-minute job limit and three more suites came within five minutes of it: configmap-sources and git-sources move from data-plane to the new suite sources; the executor and runtime scenarios of schema-approvals move to the new phase schema-runtime in the suite of that name; migration-authority becomes migration-authority-postgresql and migration-authority-mysql; and the fault rows of migrations-postgresql and migrations-mysql move to the new phases migration-faults-postgresql and migration-faults-mysql, each in a suite of that name. Each new phase adds the scenarios that stand up what it reads: watches and watch-history-audit in schema-runtime, fault-artifact in each migration-faults phase. Cells move from 27 to 42 per platform; platforms, minors and targets are unchanged. Revision 84 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.23.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 89 moves the phase reference-data-postgresql from the lifecycle suite to sources, because lifecycle reached 76.6 minutes of the 90-minute job limit on the master runs after revision 82. No phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 91 adds the scenario uninstall-first-teardown to the phase uninstall, which runs the operations page's teardown for a cluster that stays against a namespace holding one retired operation's result records inside their window; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 92 adds the scenario journal-audit-lines to the phase configmap-sources, which holds the manager's logs to the journals a schema and a migration store after their Applies: one line for each entry, equal to it, and no other line for either resource; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 95 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.26.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 96 adds the scenario mysql-refused-migration-log to the phase migration-faults-mysql, which runs a migration under apply: Always against a database whose schema_migrations_log holds an actor column too narrow for the name the run records, and reads that every entry was refused from status.lastRun, the run's RunFinished entry and RunLogged; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 97 adds the phase https-sources to the sources suite: a schema file behind Basic and a private CA reached through a same-origin redirect, a migration directory from a gzip tar behind a Bearer token, a schema file from a public zip, that zip republished with the same selected file, refused until its digest is pinned and then kept without a plan, a redirect to another origin, a credential granted for another host, a symbolic link and a .. entry in an archive, and a source policy's host list and content bound. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 101 changes the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.29.0 release image. It adds the scenario postgresql-migration-drift-check to the phase migration-faults-postgresql, which refuses an approved Apply once a column nobody migrated reaches the target, leaves out of the comparison a table the exclude list names, and applies the migration under the same check once the column is gone; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 106 adds the scenario https-ca-pin-refused to the phase https-sources, which refuses a schema whose credential Secret pins caSHA256 and whose source selects no CA before Ptah runs, with the runner's refusal in its condition, and plans the same schema once its source selects that CA; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 107 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.29.2 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 108 adds the scenario git-ca-pin-refused to the phase git-sources, which refuses a schema whose credential Secret pins caSHA256 and whose https:// source selects no CA before Ptah runs, with the runner's refusal in its condition, and plans the same schema once its source selects that CA; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 112 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.29.3 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 113 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.29.4 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 114 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.29.5 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. publishedPredecessors.evidence: Authenticated GitHub releases and tags API reads returned v0.2.0, v0.2.1, v0.2.2, v0.2.3, v0.2.4, v0.2.5, v0.2.6, v0.2.7, v0.2.8, v0.2.9, v0.2.10, v0.2.11, v0.2.12, v0.2.13 and v0.2.14, all published immutable releases, when this revision was recorded. The counts leave out the qualification-0.2.4 evidence release, its two amendments and the qualification-0.2.6 evidence release, which are not operator versions.
publishedPredecessors.disposition: v0.2.14 is the published predecessor of the next candidate. The upgrade from it is walked through both releases' guides by support/qualification/probes/fresh_install.py --upgrade-from on both platforms; the synthetic transition, refusal and recovery proofs remain required.

reassessment: Verify these hashes before a qualification run. Preserve this freeze and the original results if a profile revision changes a target. Final artifact identities and measured acceptance results are recorded separately under issues #583 and #584.
revisionReason: Move the executor the edge row of support/ptah.json verifies from Ptah v0.29.5 to the v0.30.1 release image, and record in the edge row what v0.30 changes: a PostgreSQL plan names every object with its schema and records the schema it placed unqualified names in, schema drift names objects the same way, a rebuilt view another role owns is given back to that role, schema apply refuses before any statement a plan whose view owner the login cannot give, a change Ptah cannot plan is a note in the plan, and an R__ file is a repeatable migration, which the operator refuses. The functional matrix names the new build, and the databases page describes it. Phases, scenarios, suites, cells, platforms, the profile, its targets and every other input are unchanged.
